text:
Marta: Quick capture from Statera enterprise renewal call — they're asking for an auditable request export (per-tenant, per-route, request-id) for their compliance team. Also asked for a bulk onboarding template so they can roll 12 teams next quarter.

Devin: Is the export about billing or security/audit logs?

Marta: Audit logs primarily: who called which route, model version, timestamps, and request IDs. They want HMAC-signed daily bundles or a signed CSV feed. This is a contract clause for their security review.

Pri: Sounds like a potential renewal blocker if security can't get the feed. Any example format from them?

Marta: They sent an example CSV layout in the intake doc (link: internal) — they require columns: tenant_id, route_name, model_version, iso_ts, request_id, caller_email, status_code, token_count, signature.

Yusuf: Current logs include most fields except caller_email and a signature column. We can add a signed digest easily at export time. Adding caller_email depends on downstream auth enrichment — might be available in our auth events table.

Pri: Triage: severity = renewal_risk (P0), frequency = single large account but high impact, quick-unblock feasibility = medium (2-4 engineering days for a delivery that meets compliance).

CSBot: Ticket created -> ST-501: "Statera audit export + bulk onboarding template" assigned to @Yusuf.

Devin: For short-term unblock propose two workstreams: (A) produce HMAC-signed daily CSV using existing enriched log snapshot (deliver in 72h as a manual export), (B) longer-term: add an audited export pipeline with automatic signing and S3 delivery + retention controls (2 sprints). Which does Statera prefer?

Marta: They want a short-term signed CSV as proof-of-concept and then the automated pipeline. They also want documentation so their security ops can validate signatures.

Yusuf: I'll scope the manual export. If caller_email is missing for ~5% of rows, I'll add a reconciliation flag and include an appendix of missing mappings. That should be acceptable for now.

Pri: Also asked for a bulk onboarding template: they want a CSV to upload that maps team_alias -> route_list -> quota_policy -> contact_email. Could be a simple CSV import UI (P1).

Devin: UX idea: reuse our existing customer import flow but add a "team" namespace and per-team route bundles. Minimal UI changes plus backend handler for bulk assignments — estimate 4-6d. Could also do a CLI-driven bulk assign as a faster MVP.

Marta: They prefer a UI flow they can give to non-technical PMs. So prioritize UI but maybe ship CLI first to unblock.

CSBot: Note: added risk flag "audit_export_required" to account health dashboard for Statera. Follow-up reminder in 5 days.

Yusuf: Action items:
- Yusuf: deliver manual HMAC-signed CSV export (72h). Include appendix for missing caller_email rows.
- Devin: design spec for bulk onboarding UI + CLI fallback (due 5 working days).
- Pri: draft security verification guide for signatures + retention policy doc (48h).
- Marta: customer comms + schedule proof-of-concept review next Wed 2pm PT.

Pri: I'll draft the verification guide and include a sample script to verify HMAC signatures.

Devin: I'll include wireframes for the UI and a short migration plan for 12 teams.

Marta: I'll confirm the PO at Statera for Wed 2pm and add CS->Product rollup entry. Thanks all.

CSBot: Reminder scheduled -> check ST-501 in 3 days and post status to weekly rollup.

Yusuf: Starting the export spike tonight. Will post any blockers here.

Marta: Appreciate it. This felt like a clean triage  I'll keep the thread for updates only.
